statements.t: The provision for credit losses is charged against earnings in order to maintain our ACL-Loans and ACL-Unfunded Commitments and reflects management’s best estimate of expected credit losses in our loan portfolio as of the balance sheet date.
The Company expects to incur additional core conversion-related costs in future quarters as implementation activities progress.
The allocation of the ACL-Loans at September 30, 2026 reflects our assessment of credit risk and expected credit losses within each portfolio.
We believe that the level of the ACL-Loans at September 30, 2026 is appropriate to cover expected credit losses.

Because both baseline simulations assume that our balance sheet will remain static over the simulation horizon, the results do not reflect adjustments in strategy that ALCO could implement in response to rate shifts.

estimates.name: Earnings and Performance Overview
estimates.t: Revenues (net interest income plus noninterest income) for the three months ended September 30, 2026 were $35.3 million, versus $28.5 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2025.

statements.t: Given our year-to-date performance, we are updating our full-year 2026 guidance.
We now expect net interest income of $119 to $121 million and non-interest income of $14 to $15 million, reflecting continued strength in our SBA platform.
We maintain our outlook for loan growth of 5% to 7% and non-interest expense of $65 to $67 million, excluding conversion costs.

• The Company expects to incur additional core conversion-related costs in future quarters as implementation activities progress; however, third-quarter costs were elevated by termination-related costs that are not expected to recur in future periods.
Bankwell will host a conference call to discuss the Company’s financial results and business outlook on October 29, 2026, at 11:00 a.m.
